reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM to say I've noted the possible depot move and will keep it to that DM. That reply is the only thing I did.

I didn't post or share the rumour anywhere else, and I didn't save it to gbrain or to memory. Saving it would put it where other members' conversations could reach it, which would break her request and the rule against carrying DM content elsewhere. Her message didn't ask for anything else, so I didn't look anything up.
